race.comment: OUR ULTIMATE ELSIE NZ (1) is a lightly-raced filly who looks close to a win after back-to-back placings at this circuit and distance. Missed by a just a nose two back then finished third last start. The ace draw gives her the chance to break through. MY MATE FLICKA (3) is a two-year-old colt by Century Farroh on debut for Craig Turnbull. Has the benefit of a good draw and has shown some ability with minor placings in his last two trials at Shepparton. Draws well so can be right there at the business end. RUSTY MUDSHARK (6) had a tough draw last time but had been racing consistently prior including a second from this barrier here two back. INTERNAL BLUE (5) hasn't raced for two-and-a-half years so is a query but has been readied with two trials, winning the latest.
